title: Incident #4547 — Revenue Report Overcount
scenario: The finance team reports that the monthly revenue report is showing a total that is twice as high as expected. Find the bug.
code:
SELECT
    user_id,
    SUM(amount) AS total_revenue
FROM
    orders
WHERE
    order_date >= '2026-06-01'
    AND order_date < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY
    user_id
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) > 1;

options.text: The date range in the WHERE clause is incorrect.
The HAVING clause is incorrectly assuming multiple orders per user.
The SUM function is being applied to the wrong column.
The GROUP BY clause should include order_date.

explanation: The HAVING clause is incorrectly filtering for users with more than one order, which can lead to double-counting orders for users who have multiple entries. The correct approach should directly sum the revenue without this condition. Remove the HAVING clause to get accurate totals.
